verdict.quote: The innkeeper repeatedly asked the secretary to confirm my inspection at eighteen today and said the hall would be ready. I have agreed to meet the builder at seventeen fifty-five. This could simply be preparation for a normal inspection, but I do not yet know what is being prepared or why the timing matters so much. ... My best assessment is that there may be informal discussion or preparations I have not been told about, possibly connected to the quay or the hall, but I cannot yet connect those threads or say what they are for.
